title: Twitch Affiliate
one_liner: Stream live and earn from subs and Bits once you reach the affiliate bar.
followers: 50 followers, plus 500 minutes, 7 stream days and an average of 3 viewers in 30 days.
pay: Subscriptions and Bits; Twitch publishes no fixed amount per viewer.
steps: Stream at fixed times every week.
Record every stream and clip the best minute.
Post clips on TikTok and Shorts.
Accept the affiliate invite when it arrives.
catch: The average 3 viewers is the hard part; check Twitch's own page, since rules change.

match.first_step: Pick 3 fixed stream times this week and clip each stream.
